Monitor Unity AI Gateway cost

Cost attribution uses system.billing.usage.

Field Description
usage_metadata.ai_gateway.endpoint_name Model service.
usage_metadata.ai_gateway.endpoint_id Service ID.
usage_metadata.ai_gateway.destination_model Destination model.
usage_metadata.ai_gateway.destination_id Destination ID.
identity_metadata.run_by Requester.
custom_tags Tags.

For external models, Databricks computes the estimated USD spend for each request from its token usage and the external provider's published prices. Spend is aggregated hourly in system.ai_gateway.external_model_spend. These figures might not reflect your final provider invoice.
